meta.criterion_provenance: no source. Introduced repo-wide as a 'conservative engineering electromigration-style bound' / 'BOUNDED provisioning rule, NOT an EM-safe limit'. Not a SOURCE_REQUIREMENT and not a VENDOR_REQUIREMENT; swept here rather than trusted, and no lifetime claim is attached to it
meta.em_literature_status: CONTEXT_ONLY -- solder EM reviews establish that an allowable depends on alloy, temperature, waveform, joint geometry, grain orientation, crowding and thermomigration, which is the reason no universal A/ball figure is imported here
meta.why_not_I_over_N: I_total/N_ball presumes equal sharing, which the voltage-fed network disproves; peak/equal-share ratios are reported per row
meta.crowding: OPEN. J reported here is the AVERAGE over the ball cross section. Local peak current density at the pad/UBM transition is NOT modelled and no crowding multiplier is invented

Z1__HV_S2.note: no swept count up to 240 per rail brings the SOLVED peak ball current under 1.5 A; the deficit is not a counting error but the sharing non-uniformity
